title.zh: 【Aave 创始人：Aavenomics 3.0 将包含 AAVE 回购、质押及销毁】
title.en: 【Aave 创始人：Aavenomics 3.0 将包含 AAVE 回购、质押及销毁】

current_state.zh: Aave founder Stani Kulechov said Aavenomics 3.0 will include AAVE buybacks, staking, and burning, while Aave V4's first external curator markets went live with Sentora-provided strategies.
